convention: Ex-date = official book-close date for each event (range start for SADBL, whose notice states a book-close RANGE). Last cum trading day = last trading day before the book-close date. Established from official notices stating bonus receipt for trades up to the day before book-close (BARUN, GBIME, BHCL, SNORL, GBBL, AHPC, GLBSL, SMHL, CZBIL via last trading day before a Monday book-close) and corroborated by MFIL/BARUN ex-date price signatures. Cash dividends are NEVER adjusted and never appear here. Events that could not be officially verified are listed under unverified_claims only and are never adjusted.
